blurb.bm: Padang hijau di tepi laut, tempat Francis Light mendarat, dengan Dewan Bandaraya di sebelahnya.
blurb.en: The green field by the sea where Francis Light landed, with City Hall beside it.

ask.bm: Siapa mendarat di sini pada 17 Julai 1786?

why.bm: Ya! Francis Light mendarat di sini, kemudian kawasan ini dibersihkan dan Kota Cornwallis dibina di sebelahnya.
why.en: Yes! Francis Light landed here. The area was cleared and Fort Cornwallis was built next to it.

intro.bm: Padang Kota Lama ialah padang terbuka di tepi laut George Town. Dewan Bandaraya menghadapnya.
intro.en: The Esplanade is the open field on George Town's waterfront. City Hall faces it.

bm: Francis Light pertama kali mendarat di sini pada 17 Julai 1786.
Dahulu ia padang kawad tentera, kemudian digunakan untuk sukan sejak pertengahan abad ke-19.
Dewan Bandaraya siap pada 1903 dan antara bangunan pertama di Pulau Pinang yang dilengkapi lampu dan kipas elektrik.
Ia dinamakan Dewan Bandaraya pada 1957, apabila George Town menjadi bandar raya.
en: Francis Light first landed here on 17 July 1786.
It was a military parade ground, then a sports field from the mid-19th century.
City Hall was finished in 1903 and was one of Penang's first buildings fitted with electric lights and fans.
It was named City Hall in 1957, when George Town became a city.
Fort Cornwallis at the end of the field

fun.bm: Padang ini ada Speakers' Corner, yang pertama seumpamanya di Malaysia.
fun.en: The field has a Speakers' Corner, the first of its kind in Malaysia.
